title: State at the fixed coordinate
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\rho$ assign one of the three restriction states to each of the $n$ coordinates, let $i$ be an $n$-coordinate index, and let $s\in\{\pm1\}$. After fixing coordinate $i$ according to $s$, its restriction state is the state determined by $s$.
hypotheses_covered: $\rho$ is a restriction assignment on $n$ coordinates
